description: This file defines a PHP controller class for handling project activity reports within the OrangeHRM time management module. It extends an abstract Vue controller, adds various properties to a Vue component based on request query parameters, and utilizes traits and project services to fetch project data.

classes.name: ProjectActivityReportController
classes.description: A controller class that prepares a Vue component for rendering project activity reports based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with properties like date range, project info, and inclusion of timesheet, based on request query parameters.
